summary_en: 12,600 shares (0.93% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at reference price ¥1,333/share, aggregate limit ¥16.8M, execution window 08 Aug 2026 08:45 JST (single block trade).
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Own Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 7 August 2026, FLOBAL Corporation announced a single-block own-share acquisition via ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange). The company will tender an order to purchase up to 12,600 ordinary shares at the reference price of ¥1,333 per share, with an aggregate limit of ¥16,795,800. Execution is scheduled for 10 August 2026 at 08:45 JST, immediately after which results will be published. The 12,600 shares represent 0.93% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. The Board resolved the underlying acquisition authority on 10 July 2026; this notice confirms the specific execution parameters for the final block trade. The order is subject to market conditions and execution is not guaranteed.
